sources.content:
Green Lake Park (Cuihu Park) - Complete Information

Overview
Green Lake Park, known as Cuihu Park in Chinese, represents "the most popular park in Kunming city center." This urban park blends natural landscapes with historical architecture, earning recognition as "Jade in the City."

Location & Basic Facts
- Address: 67 Cuihu South Road, Wuhua District, positioned at the foot of Luofeng Mountain
- Size: Approximately 21 hectares with roughly 15 hectares of water
- Access: Free admission
- Hours: 06:00-23:30 daily
- Visit Duration: 1-2 hours recommended
- Best Time: Year-round visitation possible

Main Scenic Areas

Mid-Lake Islet features Qing Dynasty structures including the Huxin Pavilion and Fish-viewing Pavilion, serving as venues for community activities and exhibitions.

Southeast Area showcases the Shuiyue Pavilion with three connected peninsulas and the artificial Goldfish Islet, representing "one of the most scenic areas."

Northeast Section contains the Bamboo Forest Island with approximately 40 bamboo categories, plus Nine Dragons Pond and Zhichun Pavilion where "folk artisans gather to play instruments."

Southern Area includes Palm Islet with tropical vegetation and the distinctive Nine-curved Bridge offering panoramic views.

Activities & Experiences

Natural Beauty: The park displays seasonal highlights including spring tulips, summer lotus flowers, and autumn foliage.

Local Life: Visitors encounter residents practicing Tai Chi, yoga, calligraphy, and engaging in recreational activities like chess and card games throughout the day.

Winter Bird-watching: "Tens of thousands of Siberian gulls migrate to Cuihu Park every winter" from November through March/April, attracting visitors for observation and photography.

Transportation Options
Walking/Biking: Downtown locations reach the park within approximately ten minutes.
Bus Routes: Multiple options including routes 1, 2, 5, 10, 26, 52, 54, 56, 61, 66, 69, 82, 84, 98, 100, 101, 116, 125, 133, 139, 235, 237, Z2.
Subway: Lines 2, 3, and 5 provide nearby stops requiring a 1-1.5 kilometer walk.

Nearby Attractions
- Yuantong Temple (2 km away)
- Yunnan Provincial Museum (17 km)
- Jingxing Bird and Flower Market (3 km)
- Western Hills (15 km)

sources.title: Kunming Green Lake Park, Kunming Cuihu Park - China Highlights
sources.content:
Kunming Green Lake Park, Cuihu Park

Green Lake Park, also called Cuihu Park, is situated almost in the city center and facing Yunnan University, and is one of the most beautiful parks in Kunming city. With its serene green lake surrounded by lush willows and lotus flowers, the park offers picturesque scenery all year round and is widely praised as "Jade in the City".

The park is divided by two causeways into five main sections: Mid-lake Islet (Hu Xin Dao), Goldfish Islet (Jin Yu Dao) in the southeast, Bamboo Forest Islet (Zhu Lin Dao) in the northwest, Palm Garden (Zong Lv Dao) in the southwest and the Mid-sea Pavilion (Hai Xin Ting). The Ruandi and Tangdi embankments intersect at Mid-Lake Islet, the central hub of Green Lake.

Seasonal Highlights
In spring, from late February to early April, the annual tulip festival will be held in the park; summer is the best time to appreciate blooming lotuses and lush green leaves; autumn is when the park is decorated in brilliant hues by colorful autumn leaves; and winter is the best time to observe the red-billed gulls from Siberia.

The opening hours are 07:00-23:00, entrance fee is free, and the recommended visiting time is about 1 to 2 hours.

sources.title: Green Lake Park Kunming, Green Lake Kunming, Cuihu Park - China Discovery
sources.content:
Green Lake Park Kunming

Green Lake Park (Cuihu Park) is a beautiful urban park located in the heart of Kunming, near Yunnan University. The park is known for its serene lake, willow-lined paths, and traditional pavilions.

The park has a long history dating back to the Ming Dynasty when it was used as a military training ground. Over the centuries, it was transformed into a public park with gardens, bridges, and cultural sites.

Key features include the two intersecting causeways (Ruandi and Tangdi) that divide the lake into four sections, creating a cross-shaped pattern. The park is particularly famous for the annual migration of Siberian red-billed gulls that arrive every winter.

The park is free to enter and is open from early morning to late evening. It serves as a gathering place for locals who come for exercise, socializing, and cultural activities.

sources.content:
Green Lake Park Kunming

Green Lake Park, known locally as Cuihu Park, is Kunming's most popular urban park. Located in the city center near Yunnan University, the park covers about 21 hectares with 15 hectares of water surface.

The park has been a beloved green space since the Qing Dynasty. Two historic causeways divide the lake into sections, creating a pleasant landscape of water, islands, and bridges.

Best Time to Visit: November to March for winter gull watching; spring for tulip festival; summer for lotus flowers; autumn for colorful foliage.

The park is free to enter and open daily. It's a wonderful place to observe local Kunming life, as residents come for morning exercises, dancing, card games, and socializing.

sources.title: 翠湖公园 - 百度百科
sources.content:
昆明翠湖公园完整信息汇总

基本信息
翠湖公园位于云南省昆明市五华区，是国家AAAA级景区。占地面积0.22平方千米，其中水域面积约0.12平方千米。该公园"八面水翠，四季竹翠，春夏柳翠"，享有春城"绿宝石"的美誉。

地理位置与环境
公园坐落在昆明市中心五华山西麓，与云南大学相邻。属亚热带高原山地季风气候，年均温度14.6℃。

历史沿革
元末称"菜海子"，因东北有"九泉所出，汇而成池"又名"九龙池"。明洪武十五年（1382年）沐英筑城时圈入城内，在西岸建"柳营"进行"种柳牧马"。清康熙三十一年（1692年）云南巡抚王继文在湖心岛建湖心亭，开始成为风景区。清道光十五年（1835年）总督阮元修筑南北堤，名"阮堤"。民国八年（1919年）唐继尧修筑东西堤，名"唐堤"，两堤十字相交，将湖分为四片。2002年9月25日成为昆明市首家免费开放公园。

景区布局
公园由两条著名柳堤构成十字形格局，分为五个区域：湖心岛、东南面水月轩和金鱼岛、东北面竹林岛和九龙池、南边葫芦岛和九曲桥、西边海心亭。

重要景点
观鱼楼建筑群（含莲华禅院和湖心亭）、西南岛（葫芦岛，设有人民音乐家聂耳砂石雕像）、水月轩（"翠湖嬉鸥"石刻和少女与海鸥雕塑）、九龙池（自来水历史博物馆）。

特色活动与文化
翠湖观鸥：1985年11月开始，成千上万只红嘴鸥飞临翠湖，形成"人鸥同嬉"景象。花展灯展：定期举办郁金香花展、菊花展、灯会等。

文化对联
西门："十里春风青豆角，一湾秋水白茭芽"
北门："鹤窥竹阁能衔字，鱼上莲洲欲听琴"
南门："湖势欲浮双塔去，山形如拥五华来"

参观信息
门票：免费
开放时间：全年06:00-次日00:00（23:30停止入园）
最佳季节：四季皆可
建议游玩时间：2-3小时
交通：可乘1、4、5、26、69、83、96、101、K2、54、61、133等多条公交线路到达

所获荣誉
2020年：国家AAAA级旅游景区
2024年：云南省科普基地、省级文明旅游示范单位

sources.title: Green Lake Park - IslamiChina Travel
sources.content:
Green Lake Park, Kunming

Green Lake Park (Cuihu Park) is a beloved urban oasis in the heart of Kunming. The park is known for its beautiful lake, traditional Chinese architecture, and vibrant local culture.

The park is free to enter and is open from early morning to late evening. It is particularly popular during winter months when thousands of Siberian red-billed gulls migrate to the lake, creating a spectacular wildlife viewing experience.

Visitors can enjoy walking along the willow-lined causeways, visiting the pavilions and temples scattered around the lake, and observing local residents engaged in traditional activities like tai chi, music, and dancing.
